faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long does a premium site take?
faq.a1: It depends on scope, but most projects go from briefing to live in 3 to 6 weeks. The proposal includes a timeline with concrete dates — and we keep it.
faq.a2: Each proposal is tailored to scope: number of pages, languages, integrations. Send us your goal and within 48h you have a fixed price — no surprises mid-project.
faq.q3: I already have a site. Is it worth redoing?
faq.a3: First we run a free diagnosis of your current site: speed, SEO and conversion. If it's good, we tell you so — and you know where you stand. If it isn't, we show you exactly what it's costing you in customers.
faq.a4: The technical SEO base (structure, schema.org, sitemap, performance) is included in every project — it's how we build, not an add-on. Ongoing content strategy is a separate service.
faq.q5: After launch, am I on my own?
faq.a5: No. Every project includes post-launch support, and you can add continuous evolution: monitoring, reports and monthly improvements driven by your visitors' real data.
faq.q6: Does the site connect to a CRM?
faq.a6: Yes — forms can connect to your current CRM or to Branct CRM, our platform with AI that answers your leads on WhatsApp 24/7. Site and CRM from the same house means zero leads lost between systems.
